The failed Intel review, routine maintenance and unchanged alert triage were excluded for acceptance or audience-value reasons. Current ratings and Buy/Sell conditions were covered for Prosus, Tencent, Uber, Crocs and NVIDIA. The deterministic script preflight passed, and the single audited draft-render invocation succeeded with a 1,326-second ephemeral audio draft.
